messages:
Nina (PM): Quick call: AcmeCorp asked to include tenant-level telemetry export (S3 + syslog) in our next pilot. This is a high-touch enterprise ask that affects compliance and infra. We need to decide: fold into MVP for pilot tenants, or mark as v1 and provide a temporary workaround? Need a decision today to update the milestone board.

Diego (Eng): Export plumbing is straightforward for a single tenant but needs ACL/KMS checks, more e2e tests, and an ops path. Estimate 1 sprint to add export + tests + rollout gating. If we ship in MVP we should gate it behind tenant opt-in + audit logs.

Priya (Legal): If we support syslog/S3 we need a data processing addendum for log retention and PII filtering. We can fast-track the DPA addendum but it will take 3-5 business days sign-off from legal review. Also need clear customer-configurable retention defaults.

Kevin (Sales): AcmeCorp is explicit: we either have telemetry export for pilot or they won't sign the pilot agreement. Their pilot start is in 10 business days. They will accept a 'pilot-only' feature if it's behind an opt-in flag and contractually limited.

Ravi (Infra): Ops note: exports will increase egress and storage. For a single tenant it's fine but if we productize we need quotas and billing. I can stand up a dedicated export worker + policy in the canary infra. Also recommend throttling per-tenant export rate out of the box.

Diego (Eng): Two rollout options: 1) MVP pilot-only opt-in: implement tenant-export with audit hooks, opt-in flag, and temporary rate-limits. 2) Defer to v1 but offer a manual transfer process (we push logs to a secure staging bucket and share). Option 1 is ~1 sprint; option 2 is ~3-4 days of manual ops work but not productized.

Nina (PM): Tradeoffs: Option 1 satisfies sales and short timeline if we accept legal help and ops gating. Option 2 is lower product risk but could lose the pilot. We need to weigh roadmap impact (this would pull resources from the embeddings cache and rollout automation work).

Priya (Legal): If we go Option 1, Legal will need the feature spec and the retention defaults. We can prioritize the DPA review but need a commit from Sales that this is pilot-only and limited scope.

Kevin (Sales): I can get the pilot-limited contract addendum drafted today and ping Acme. They'll sign off fast if we label it "pilot telemetry export: opt-in, retention 30 days, no redistribution".

Diego (Eng): Operational gates I'll need in the PR:
```
feature: tenant_export
  opt_in: true
  retention_default_days: 30
  rate_limit_per_tenant: 10MB/s
  audit_log: enabled
```
I'll also add canary routing to a single region and a kill-switch flag.

Ravi (Infra): I'll pre-provision a staging bucket with KMS and short-lived credentials for the pilot. Also will add billing meter for export bytes so we can surface cost to the pilot owner.

milestone-bot: Milestone updated: "Pilot telemetry export (opt-in)" moved to MVP candidate lane. Owner: Nina. ETA: +7 days.

Nina (PM): Proposed decision: Ship as MVP pilot-only opt-in (Option 1) with strict gates: Legal DPA ready, opt-in default off, retention default 30 days, infra throttles + billing meter, and a rollback kill-switch. If any gate misses, we revert to manual ops (Option 2) and keep feature in v1 backlog.

Diego (Eng): Agreed. I'll scope a 1-sprint plan, open PR with the feature flags and tests, and request an expedited code review.

Priya (Legal): I'll start DPA draft now. Need feature spec link from Nina.

Kevin (Sales): I'll draft the pilot addendum and send to AcmeCorp for signature.

Ravi (Infra): I'll provision the staging resources and add the billing meter.

Nina (PM): I'll update the milestone board with the MVP decision and shift embeddings-cache work to next sprint. Adding note: "Pilot-only telemetry export; rollback to manual transfer if gates fail."

Kevin (Sales): :thumbsup: Will confirm contract and share status.

Diego (Eng): One more ask 1 : we should add a smoke test that validates that exported files arrive and retain correct ACLs. Kicking that off in CI.

Nina (PM): Thanks all. Decision recorded and milestone moved. Closing thread unless blockers.
